envelope_from.description: The SMTP MAIL FROM reverse path, captured at ingest: "" for a bounce's null sender <>, null only for mail stored before it was kept — never backfilled from the header From (decision 0044 §8)

recipients.description: The envelope recipients (RCPT TO), Bcc included; the `to` filter matches these as well as the To/Cc headers

codes.description: Likely OTP/verification codes (4–10 ASCII digits), extracted at ingest: at most the first 64 distinct, in extraction order (decision 0049); a row stored before the cap keeps its array verbatim

message_id.description: The Message-ID header value, angle brackets stripped; absent when the mail has none

in_reply_to.description: The first In-Reply-To id; absent when the mail has none

references.description: The References ids in header order; absent when the mail has none

probability.description: Percentage chance the event fires. The shared domain is the integer range 0–100. Values 101 through 255 are domain refusals with native JSON 400: probability must be an integer between 0 and 100. Negative, omitted, null, wrong type and values above 255 fail extraction with plain-text 422. A null event clears that event; it is not a probability value (decisions 0025, 0048).

error.description: Optional SMTP reply line; omission uses the stage's default. It starts with three ASCII digits whose first digit is 4 or 5. If any bytes follow the code, byte four is ASCII space; bare codes and a trailing space are legal. No CR or LF. Maximum 510 UTF-8 octets, including all bytes of non-ASCII text and excluding the CRLF appended on the wire. Supplied null is refused with 422 (decisions 0029, 0044).

delay_ms.description: Optional delay in milliseconds; omission defaults to 0. Values above the 300000 ms stage-timer ceiling are refused, never clamped (decision 0029).

ChaosConfig.description: A null event clears that event's rule. Omitted events remain unset when REST replaces the whole configuration.
